decisions.reason: Names the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as the koffi.node holder; the mapped PE image keeps a kernel file lock until the process exits, so npm's copyfile of the installed file hits EBUSY.

Refresh reloads only the client SPA against the same live host; ordered steps: stop every dsh process (host + session workers), verify no node.exe remains, install, restart with hard refresh; only dsh-related processes targeted.
Bare package name is shorthand for @latest = 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5; installing it over 0.1.2-alpha.4 is a silent downgrade, not a preserve-or-upgrade; next also points at rc.2.

Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, requires dsh --version to print alpha.5 before restart; @alpha presented only as a secondary tag-based option.

Advises authors to never ship a bare dsh spec — pin the exact tested version or use a deliberately chosen channel tag — and to avoid folding an unpinned core upgrade into a plugin install command that silently follows latest.
